description: This is an ASP.NET Web Forms code-behind file for the AdminLeaderboard page, managing server-side events and interactions related to the admin leaderboard view in an online examination system.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.AdminLeaderboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminLeaderboard ASP.NET page, handling page load and button click events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event. Currently, it contains commented-out code for loading user info into a grid view.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminPanel.aspx page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminQueue.aspx page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handler for the leaderboard button; currently does nothing.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Sets session variable with selected semester; contains commented-out code for database search functionality.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the LoginPage.aspx for logout.
